{{Attr|Health Regen}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Actor2''', which uses the display name of just '''Actor''', was a summon only enemy in [[The Narratorium]] as part of [[The Final Act Event]]. Originally, it was the second actor that appeared in [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]]. It has a high amount of health and defense, but a slow speed. The '''Actor2''' has [[Splash Damage Immunity]], meaning splash damage cannot damage it and [[Stun Immunity]], making it harder to stall. It can be spawned by the [[Enigma (Nil Zone)|Enigma]], [[Corrupted Conserver (Nil Zone)|Corrupted Conserver]], [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]], [[Producer]] and [[Painter]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Without all three actors, the production would have been impossible, yet this one delivered a particularly stunning performance. They led the others toward their master's ultimate goal, a plan set in motion from day one. Although, they couldn’t shake a horrifying sensation. The feeling that someone could effortlessly erase them.''" ==Appearance== '''Actor2''' is an armored black humanoid that wears a white colored happy theater mask. It wears a horned helmet, grey chestplate, brown gloves, brown boots and a dark purple shirt. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] and [[Nil Zone]] is listed instead. *Towers like [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Ranger]] are recommended to take down the '''Actor2''' thanks to their high DPS. *As the '''Actor2''' has [[Splash Damage Immunity]], there is no point to use [[Splash Damage]] against it. **Towers that entirely deal [[Splash Damage]], such as the [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]], will not be able to damage the '''Actor2''' at all. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} Actor2Walk.gif|Walking animation (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseActor2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} Actor2IconIG.png|'''Actor2''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy was first used in [[The Great Finale]] as part of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. ==Update History== *'''4 October 2025''' -
